epics.title: Frontend Build and Static Serving Integration
epics.jtbd: When a real user opens the launched product, I want the backend to serve the built static frontend output, so that the user sees the actual UI instead of a bare API.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase proportion of successful frontend requests from 0% to 100% on the root path.
epics.tocConstraintRef: Docker build and backend static serving configuration
requirements: R1: The Dockerfile must run npm ci and npm run build in the frontend/ directory.
R2: The backend must be configured to serve the built static output from the frontend.

slices.title: Update Dockerfile and backend configuration to serve frontend
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend build for this epic, I want to update the Dockerfile and backend serving logic, so that the actual UI is visible to the user.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Docker build process
When building the image
Then npm ci and npm run build are executed for the frontend.
Given a deployed application
When a user requests the root path
Then the backend serves the compiled static UI instead of a bare API.
Given the CI pipeline
When the backend tests run
Then they assert that static resources are correctly served.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase proportion of successful frontend UI loads from 0% to 100%.

epics.title: Implementable HTML Design Generation Fix
epics.jtbd: When the design shop triggers generation, I want the output to include an implementable mockup.html, so that UI implementation can proceed without being blocked.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of generation runs producing implementable HTML from 0% to 100%.
requirements: R1: The design generator must use a model capable of outputting HTML rather than gemini-3.1-flash-image.
R2: The generator output must include a valid mockup.html file instead of only metadata.

slices.title: Patch design generator to produce HTML
slices.jtbd: When implementing the generator fix for this epic, I want to change the model and output instructions, so that an implementable mockup.html is reliably created.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the design generation script
When executed
Then it calls an HTML-capable model instead of gemini-3.1-flash-image.
Given a completed generation run
When examining the draft folder
Then a mockup.html file is present for implementation.
Given the generator test suite
When the tests are run
Then the tests assert that a valid HTML payload is requested and produced.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the rate of missing mockup.html artifacts from 100% to 0%.
